task: Risk is tracked in three places here and nobody has reconciled them: `project_risk_register_2025q1.xlsx` holds project risk, `version_release_risk_tracker_v3_8_v4_0.xlsx` holds release risk for v3.8 to v4.0, and `techflow_2025h2version_risk_tracker.xlsx` covers the second half of 2025. Merge them into one register, deduplicating risks appearing in more than one source and recording which sources each came from — the same risk is usually worded differently in each, so match on substance rather than wording. Attach the mitigation from `high_priority_risk_response_plan.docx` where one exists, and attach any entry from `issue_tracking_ledger_v5_9iteration.xlsx` that is the risk having already materialised. Produce the merged register, a list of risks carrying neither mitigation nor owner, and a note explaining the matching decisions where two entries were similar but not obviously the same risk.
